title: Ordered Delivery, Idempotency, Checkpoint & Reconnect Recovery
selected_by_owner: Strict successor after owner-approved PCV-03 decomposition and PCV-03C completed_verified closeout.
objective: Commands, Events and reconnect use serialized host authority, semantic idempotency, durable cursors/checkpoints and current authorization without event loss or duplicate business effects.
acceptance: Serialize authoritative per-Session mutations so ordered transport cannot race durable reads/writes.
Narrow PCV-03 commands to PCV-03-owned schemas and reject conflicting reuse of an idempotency key via payload fingerprint.
Use host-authoritative receipt/Event timestamps rather than client clock claims.
Separate authoritative durable stream cursor from the visible player Event list and acknowledge only state actually delivered/processed.
Consume canonical ordered delivery to detect duplicates, gaps and cross-Session input and trigger authoritative recovery.
Advance content-hashed checkpoints/replay fingerprints over Session progress.
Reconnect revalidates current identity, membership, permission and Session status; post-membership transport resume does not require issuing another Campaign invitation.
PCV-03E+ and PCV-04 remain unauthorized until this item closes.
boundaries: Preserve PCV-03A canonical A3 identity/invitation and A5 Campaign membership authority, PCV-03B canonical A5 Session lifecycle/authority-epoch state, and PCV-03C peer-bound transport/protocol/capability surfaces; ordered delivery/recovery consumes them rather than replacing them.
Implement only PCV-03-owned serialized Session-continuity commands, idempotent durable Events/outbox delivery, viewer-safe cursors/ACKs, checkpoints/replay fingerprints and reconnect recovery.
Use one canonical Session history and current authority epoch; transport ordering, client timestamps, role claims and connection state never become authoritative truth.

Reconnect must revalidate current identity/device, membership, permissions, entitlement, Session lifecycle and epoch; an already-authorized member does not require a new Campaign invitation merely to replace transport.
Do not add a generic gameplay command escape hatch; gameplay/action/combat authority remains PCV-04+.
Do not implement PCV-03E presence UX, PCV-03F installed packaging/certification, or PCV-04 gameplay.
Use milestone-level OPS3 state only; no activity-journal instrumentation.
